title: Holographic thermal propagator at finite energy from modularity and triality
summary: We extend the modularity-based approach of arXiv:2509.02226 for the holographic thermal propagator to the physically relevant case of nonzero energy $ω$. Via the AGT correspondence, the problem is mapped to $\mathcal{N}=2$ $SU(2)$ gauge theory with $N_f=4$ hypermultiplets. Turning on $ω$ activates all four hypermultiplet masses, so that the full $SO(8)$ flavor symmetry constrains the low-temperature expansion, rather than the subgroup left unbroken at $ω=0$.
